details: On July 9, President Trump announced the US ceasefire with Iran was "over" during the NATO summit in Ankara. This declaration led to a roughly 3% drop in Bitcoin's price and a 5% jump in oil prices. The move follows recent US strikes on Iran, which were a response to attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz, intensifying geopolitical risks in the Middle East.
title: Trump Declares US-Iran Ceasefire Over, Markets React

details: The United States plans to license Ukraine to manufacture Patriot air-defense systems, fulfilling a long-standing request from Kyiv. Additionally, US senators have agreed with the Trump administration to pursue tougher sanctions against Russia, potentially targeting countries that continue to purchase Russian oil and gas. These actions signal increased military and economic pressure on Moscow.
title: US to License Patriot Systems for Ukraine, Plans Tougher Russia Sanctions

details: European nations are considering proposals for non-compulsory navigation fees in the Strait of Hormuz. This development comes as US officials urge Iran to publicly guarantee safe passage for shipping in the critical oil chokepoint. The region has seen recent disruptions, with the "US-Israel war on Iran" being cited as a backdrop, leading to oil price volatility.
title: Europe Weighs Navigation Fees for Strait of Hormuz Amid Tensions

details: The European Commission is preparing to revise its landmark Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework, shortly after its full implementation. The proposed revisions aim to extend MiCA's scope to include non-EU issuers and address emerging trends such as tokenized securities. This initiative is influenced by global regulatory developments and the significant growth in stablecoin transaction volumes.
title: EU Plans Revision of MiCA Crypto Framework for Expansion
